parsed.internal_thinking: I need a second settlement that provides Wheat and Ore to balance my initial Brick/Sheep/Wood setup at node 12. Node 43 is the strongest production-wise with 13 pips of Wheat (9, 6, 9), but it lacks Ore entirely. Node 25 offers a better mix: Wheat (8), Ore (3), and Sheep (4) with 10 pips, which is more balanced for development cards and cities. Node 44 also has 10 pips but is heavy on Wheat. Given my need for Ore, node 25 is the most strategic choice to ensure I have all the necessary resources for the mid-game, even if the pips are slightly lower than 43.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed second settlement on node 25. This gives me access to Wheat 8, Ore 3, and Sheep 4. My production is now balanced across all resources except for a consistent high-yield Ore. I should prioritize upgrading to cities or getting more Ore soon.
parsed.say_outloud: אני אלך על הפינה הזאת. אני באמת רק מחפש קצת שקט, אולי איזה כבשה או שתיים וקצת אבן לבנות לעצמי משהו צנוע. אין צורך להתרגש, ג'ימי, אני רחוק מהדרכים שלך.
